_doc: Branch-days whose STORED data is known to be another branch's data. Readers blank these records at load time (buys/sells emptied, error set); the encrypted archive files are never rewritten, so removing an entry restores the original record. Matching is by exact, case-sensitive branch code and the file's trade date (YYYYMMDD). Helper: src/core/quarantine.py
